0.description: Fixed an issue where some select items from the store were bind on pickup instead of bind on use. This requires you to clear your cache to see the updated binding.
Raised the weapon damage of PvP gladiator weps on Gul Dan.

7.description: Graceful Stride speed has been reduced from 15% to 10%.
Inescapable Roots now also makes your Entangling Roots break easier from damage.
The Inescapable Roots debuff now has diminishing returns and will only last for half the duration of the Entangling Roots.
Fixed an exploit where the Stealth effect from Shroud of Concealment could be kept longer than intended.

1.description: Brambles no longer increases damage done by Entangling Roots.
Mangle (Bear) now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Conflagrate now deals 5% increased damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Sunder Soul now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Mangle (Cat) now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 30%.
Seal of Command now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Thunder Clap no longer deals reduced damage against players. It previously had a PvP modifier of 5%.
Mongoose Bite now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Mind Flay now deals 5% increased damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Immolate now deals 5% increased damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Mangle (Bear) now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Insect Swarm now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Scorch now deals 5% increased damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Backstab now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Hammer of the Righteous now deals 5% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.

5.description: Shard of the Fallen Star heroic now deals 75% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.

0.description: AQR set items will now have a vendor price.
Fixed an issue where the PvE Raid Weekly quest would sometimes not appear.
A True Artisan will now reward 5500 Marks up from 3500 and 45 Mystic Orbs up from 15 Mystic Orbs. This will require you to clear your cache to see the updated values
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where you couldn't pick up Honorable Combat, Battlefield Quests & Death to the Felforged at the same time.
[Pending Restart] 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 dailies will now cycle in chronological order rather than being random per day.
Doubled the price vendors will pay for Bloodforged items. (This change will be active after the next server restart.)
[Battlegrounds]: Players below maximum level can now queue for Random Battlegrounds.

7.description: Fixed a bug where Arcane Explosion casted from War Mage RE would cause damage at the initial location.

1.description: Fixed a bug where Healing Stream Totem would be affected twice by healing reduction effects.

Fixed a bug where auras with multiple spell modifiers would not stack. This will fix an interaction with Molten Core, Devastation and Soul Leach Capstone would not give combined crit chance modifiers.

7.description: Fixed an issue where Shroud of Concealment did not make you invisible while conjuring food or water.
Fixed an issue where the cooldown of Sunfire could be bypassed. In addition, Sunfire can now hit a maximum of five targets per cast.
Fixed an issue where area effect damage from Sunfire could hit stealthed targets.
Sunfire now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
[Area 52] Fixed an issue where Bulwark wouldn't teach you the ability. (Re-equip the Mystic Enchant to get the ability.)

5.description: [Fel-Infused Gateway]: Changed the range at which it can be used near certain locations.

7.description: Fixed an issue where the buff from Wild Aggression wouldn't be consumed properly.

5.description: [League 2] [AQR] [Items] Pending Restart: AQR and AQT exclusive recipes will no longer be bind on pick up.

0.description: Fixed an issue where the Wrath 5 set would increase instead of decrease the cooldown of the abilities listed.
Corrected an issue where players could complete sometimes more than 1 quest with a temporal contract.

Shadowstrike base damage has been reduced to 100 from 250. its tooltip will now also update correctly with how much damage it will do. It now scales 14% spell power (up from 8%) and deals 20% less damage in pvp.

Thunderstrike base damage has been reduced to 100 from 250. its tooltip will now also update correctly with how much damage it will do. It now scales 14% attack power (up from 9%) and deals 30% less damage in pvp.

Fixed an issue where Vis'kag the Bloodletter & Drake Fatal Wound wasn't scaling with attack power (related to itemization changes) it will now scale with 15% of your attack power and now deals 35% less damage in pvp.
Created a Temporal Contract for Ahn Qiraj Gate Opening Event (you will only be able to see this if you have quest) this scroll costs 150g.
Created a Temporal Contract for Battle Field (group pvp) this scroll costs 50g.
Created a Temporal Contract for Battle Field (pvp) this scroll costs 50g.

7.description: Reduced the damage of the Twilight Paragon effects in PvP.
Fixed an issue where Bulwark Random Enchant wouldn't teach the Bulwark spell correctly.
Fixed a bug where Wild Wrath didn't get its ranged attack power scaling bonus applied properly. [Pending restart]

6.description: [League 2] [AQR] Silicate Feeder inside AQR once again drop Larval Acid, a reagent required to craft items associated to AQR and the Cenarion Circle faction recipes.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred will now start summoning Void Tentacle at 30% health.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Void Singularities will now become unstable at 50% rather then 75% health, starting to hurl Dark Volley at nearby enemies.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Void Singularities Ever Expanding Void now increases Ossirians damage dealt by 3% down from 5% per stack.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Void Singularities will now always spawn from the centre of the room rather from the stairs that lead up to Ossitian the Unscarred.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred will now start summoning Void Singularities when he reaches 65% health.

[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Re-enabled the Sand Vortex mechanic. Sand Vortex travel trough the area, applying Harsh Winds to enemies that come to close. Harsh Winds deal nature damage per second, reduce enemies movement speed by 50% and interrupt spell casting if the target stands in the eye of an Sand Vortex.

[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Corrected an issue where it was possible for the target of Meteor to kill itself by travelling over a long distance while the animation of the Meteor was already in progress, not sharing the damage with party members by using abilities such as blink.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Meteor now has a 4 second cast time and will apply a visual indicator to its target.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred's Meteor will now function like most other Meteors, dealing damage to the target shared with all other targets around it.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Corrected an issue where Ossirian the Unscarred's Plague ability would scale with the effected targets damage increasing and damage reducing effects.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred will no longer change his starting abilities depending on his % health.

[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred will no longer use his Thunderclap ability, instead he will use his Stomp ability more frequently and his Stomp ability will act like a Thunderclap.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred will no longer use his Shadow Storm ability and will no longer summon Qiraji Warriors or Qiraji Lashers.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] A raid warning is now shown when Ossirian changes phase and whenever a Void Singularity spawns.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ossirian the Unscarred] Ossirian the Unscarred has been reworked.
[League 2] [AQR] [Moam] Moam will now always start combat with 50% of his Mana pool.
[League 2] [AQR] [Moam] A raid warning is now shown when Moam begins to cast Mana Meltdown.

[League 2] [AQR] [Moam] Moam's Arcane Explosion (Big) has been renamed to Mana Meltdown. Mana Meltdown now has a 10 second cast time and will obliterate all enemies within 40 yards around Moam. Targets further away take less damage. Targets that survive are infused with Mana that Moam can feed on again.
[League 2] [AQR] [Moam] Greatly improved the readability of Moam's abilities.
[League 2] [AQR] [Moam] Moam has been reworked.
[League 2] [AQR] [Ayamiss the Hunter] Ayamiss the Hunter will now use Stinger spray at an increased frequency when her health falls below 20%.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Brood Guards Vulnerability ability now stacks up to a maximum of 25 stacks down from 100.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Brood Guards now require their target to be in melee range in order to lay their eggs.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Corrected an issue where Buru's Brood Guards would prefer walking over flying.
[League 2] [Buru the Gorger] A raid warning is now shown whenever Buru becomes vulnerable or restores his defence.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Buru the Gorger will now apply a visual indicator to the target she is currently interested in.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Buru's Egg can no longer parry attacks.
[League 2] [AQR] [Buru the Gorger] Greatly improved readability and information given by Buru's ability tooltipps.
[League 2] [AQR] [General Rajaxx] General Rajaxx now owns his Captains, Lieutenants and Colonel, making them part of the General Rajaxx encounter.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Sand Trap no longer deals damage or silences effected targets. Sand Trap now reduces effected targets chance to hit, dodge and parry by 50%.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Increased the duration of Mortal Wound to 30 seconds up from 15.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Wide Slash now has a 3 second cast time, deals 200% weapon damage up from 100% and Kurinnaxx will not turn during its cast.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Kurinnaxx will now use his Wide Slash ability always together with his Teleport Player ability.

[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Kurinnaxx Adaptive Carapace will now adapt Kurinnaxx defence if he is hit by spells and abilities that inherit more then 1. spell school. Hitting Kurinnaxx with such abilities while the player is drenched in Acid will also increase Kurinnaxx vulnerability to all inherit spell schools.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Increased the duration of Drenched in Acid to 30 seconds up from 15 seconds.
[League 2] [AQR] [Kurinnaxx] Only 1 Spawn of Kurinnaxx will now spawn on all difficulties.
[League 2] [AQR] [Items] Added a Heroic version of The Head of Ossirian.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] Kurinnaxx and General Rajaxx now drop a handful of items that previously could only drop from General Rajaxx Captains, Lieutenants and Colonel.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] Moam and Ossirian now exclusively drop set weapons.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] Buru the Gorger and Ayamiss the Hunter now exclusively drop set rings.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] Kurinnaxx and General Rajaxx now exclusively drop set cloaks.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] Re-distributed some items from Moam's loot table over Kurinnaxx, General Rajaxx, Buru the Gorger and Ayamiss the Hunter to even out the size of the loot table.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] All boss encounter before Ossirian the Unscarred now have a chance to drop Recipes from AQR and AQT.
[League 2] [AQR] [General] All boss encounter now have proper checkpoints.

5.description: Fel Enchanted Warchest will now grant 4 bags per opening instead of causing players to open them over & over & over to get the bags on starting characters.

7.description: Fixed another issue with Focused Burst.

6.description: [League 2] [BWL] [Chromaggus] Chromaggus will now take 10% more damage from all sources on heroic difficulty.
[League 2] Decreased the damage, healing and health of all mobs in BWL on all difficulties by 5%.
